text:
HD Hyundai Heavy Industries said Monday it has secured a 272.1 billion-won ($203.6 million) contract to build four liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) carriers.
The South Korean shipbuilder said it will build the vessels for an undisclosed client in Oceania and deliver them by September 2029.
The latest contract accounts for 1.55 percent of the company's annual sales, according to its regulatory filing.
